extraFocus: Every server action checks the session or permissions itself and validates its input with zod (docs/seguridad-owasp.md).
The database is reached only through Prisma or tagged $queryRaw, and user-supplied URLs are fetched only through safeFetch.
Reads that are the same for everyone go through cached() and list every table they read in models; code that signs URLs or depends on the request calls await connection() first.
The community name is spelled programaConNosotros everywhere users can see it (lowercase only in domains, handles and repo names).
Prisma types and the client come from @/generated/prisma/client (or /browser in client components), never @prisma/client.
